newsitem.title: USA: Thomaston Mills sees better earnings.
newsitem.headline: Thomaston Mills sees better earnings.

text.p: Thomaston Mills Inc said on Wednesday it was optimistic about its earnings and sales prospects for the fiscal year ending June 1997 due to an improving economy and retail environment.
Thomaston, which continued an "aggressive" capital spending program in fiscal 1996, said its improved facilities position it to take advantage of the improved textile business climate.
In the fiscal year ended June 29, the company reported earnings of $615,000, or $0.09 a share on sales of $277.7 million.
